content: Post-transplantation diabetes mellitus (PTDM) should be screened for in patients after transplantation once their condition has stabilized. The oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) is the preferred diagnostic method for identifying PTDM. When managing immunosuppressive therapy, the treatment plan should prioritize optimizing both graft function and overall patient outcomes. This approach should be maintained regardless of the patient's risk of developing PTDM.
